verdict.rationale: The evidence shows TrueLayer verifying account ownership, reading account data, and storing bank details for reuse within its own payments flows. It also documents webshop plugins (WooCommerce, Shopify, Magento), but those add TrueLayer as a payment method rather than passing linked-account credentials to an external processor. Nothing documents a processor-token exchange or a partner integration that hands verified account credentials to a third-party processor or platform.
